ai_overview.answer_markdown:
If you're in **Braybrook, VIC**, there are several locksmiths that install smart locks for homes and apartments.

Some good nearby options include:

- Aus Lock & Safe Company (Sunshine West) – Installs digital and keyless locks, access control systems, and offers 24/7 mobile locksmith services. Their Braybrook service page specifically mentions smart lock installation. [www.auslock.com.au](https://www.auslock.com.au/pages/locksmith/braybrook?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Lock, Smith and Barrel (West Footscray) – Highly rated 24/7 locksmith with experience installing residential smart locks.
- Kolliou Locksmiths (Sunshine) – Long-established local locksmith offering lock replacement and installation services.
- Onpoint locksmith (Footscray) – Mobile locksmith servicing the inner west, including smart lock installations.

Typical installation costs in Melbourne are approximately:
- Retrofit smart lock (replacing the inside thumb-turn): **A$100–A$200**.
- Full smart deadbolt or mortice lock installation: **A$180–A$350+**, depending on the door and whether drilling or modifications are required. Community reports for Braybrook jobs generally fall within this range. [www.airtasker.com](https://www.airtasker.com/au/services/lock-installation/braybrook-vic/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you already have a lock in mind (such as Yale, Aqara, Eufy, Samsung, Schlage, or Lockly), I can also tell you:
- whether it's compatible with your door,
- whether a locksmith or handyman is the better choice, and
- what the expected installation cost should be.
